description: Ultimate Waterfall Chart for Power BI is a certified custom visual designed for professional financial reporting, management dashboards, variance analysis, and IBCS®-style business reporting. Create clear and insightful waterfall charts with both horizontal and vertical chart orientation, flexible formatting options, and advanced visual customization. The visual supports key waterfall chart elements such as contributions, subtotals, totals, start values, and deviation calculations, making it ideal for profit and loss analysis, budget vs. actual reporting, sales performance, financial bridges, and executive dashboards. With the paid version, users can unlock advanced customization options, including custom colors for contribution values, subtotals, totals, start values, and deviation calculations. The paid license also removes the watermark for a clean, professional report experience. As a certified Power BI custom visual, Ultimate Waterfall Chart supports features such as Export to PowerPoint and Power BI report page subscriptions, making it suitable for enterprise reporting and recurring business presentations. To remove the watermark, order your trial or paid license by contacting license@dataviz.boutique or visiting dataviz.boutique. Discover more Power BI visuals, new versions, and financial reporting solutions inspired by the IBCS® Standard at Dataviz Boutique.
